The correct answer is Texas Tech University, but there was confusion with Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center (TTUHSC). 

Looking at the conversation, the Planner kept asking WebSurfer to search for information, but WebSurfer kept bringing up Wikipedia entries that said the team represented TTUHSC, which is incorrect. The Planner tried multiple times to get accurate information but didn't get it until the very end. 

I think the mistake was made by WebSurfer because they were providing information from Wikipedia that was misleading. The Planner was trying to get accurate info but kept getting conflicting results. So, the error started when WebSurfer first found the incorrect information on Wikipedia. That was step 1, where WebSurfer provided the wrong attribution. 

The reason for the mistake is that WebSurfer relied on Wikipedia without verifying it against authoritative sources like the official Texas Tech University website. This led to the Planner having to repeatedly ask for confirmation, but the damage was done as the wrong information was already presented.
</think>

Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1
